features: Compact Home Gym Flooring Solution: This 36" x 78" thick mat (0.24") fits spin bikes and treadmills perfectly. Rolls up for easy storage—ideal for small home gym spaces.
Dual-Texture Non-Slip Protection: Textured top prevents equipment slippage; reinforced backing grips floors securely, even during intense workouts.
Noise-Reducing Shock Absorption: 6mm high-density PVC minimizes vibrations and workout noise, ideal for home gyms in apartments or shared spaces.
Waterproof & Low-Maintenance Surface: Blocks sweat and spills—wipe clean instantly with a damp cloth. Protects floors from stains and moisture damage.
Durable Gym Flooring for Heavy Equipment: Tear-resistant PVC withstands heavy home gym machines. Safeguards hardwood, tile, and laminate flooring long-term.
